headline: 🔥 TWO THINGS LANDED AFTER LUNCH THAT WERE NOT ON THIS BOARD AT NOON — 225 WILLOW POINT TOOK THE FIRST SHOWING OF ITS LIFE AT 4:30 THIS AFTERNOON, AND THERE IS AN OFFER IN HAND ON 198 RENA DR WITH YOUR NAME ALREADY ON A PROMISE TO CALL THE SELLER. ⭐ THE RENA ONE IS THE URGENT HALF: at 3:50 PM your closing coordinator emailed the seller a net sheet and told him “Gene will give you a call to discuss in just a few” — that promise is now two and a half hours old and the seller is holding a PDF nobody has walked him through. ✅ AND ONE ALARM FROM THIS AFTERNOON IS NOW DISPROVEN: the theory that ShowingTime stopped routing to you is wrong — the Willow Point confirmation landed in your own inbox at 3:25 PM. Only the REQUEST notice never came.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 AN OFFER, NOT A FORM — and your name is already on a promise. At 3:50 PM your closing coordinator emailed the seller an estimated net sheet on a live offer and wrote “Gene will give you a call to discuss in just a few”; nine minutes later she texted that the buyers can move the close to 9/21 and the preapproval was on its way. She had already tried the seller by phone and gotten voicemail.
hotSignals.action: Call the seller tonight and walk him through the net sheet line by line — and say the contingency out loud: these buyers must close their own house on 9/21 first. Do not let a PDF he has not been walked through be the first version of this offer he forms an opinion about.

hotSignals.signal: 🆕 THE FIRST SHOWING OF THIS LISTING'S LIFE WAS HELD AT 4:30 THIS AFTERNOON, DAY THREE ON MARKET — and it was 21 seconds from being rescheduled. The buyer's agent texted at 2:55 PM asking whether the 4:30 was still on “or do I need to reschedule for tomorrow” with nobody answering; the confirmation came through at 3:25 PM.
hotSignals.action: Call the buyer's agent tomorrow morning for a read while the walk-through is fresh — there is no feedback form on this address yet and a first tour on a three-day-old listing is the most honest price signal you will get all week. Then call the sellers with it; the seller note is drafted and unsent in your Gmail.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 STILL THE BEST BUYER READ ON THE BOARD AND NOW ON DAY SIX. Amy G. of Ethos International filed interested — YES and wrote that her buyers have just started looking, really like the property, and it is at the TOP of their list. She also phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so this is a returned call, not a cold one. She left “priced right” blank and reported the basement lights would not come on.
hotSignals.action: Call her — do not write. Two questions: what would it take, and what is behind the blank price answer. Then answer the basement lights, which is the only complaint on this file nobody has addressed and is probably a breaker, not a repair bill.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 NOT A SHOWINGTIME FORM — THE BUYER HIMSELF, BY TEXT. Adin D. named his gap under the ask, told you to save his number as a standing investor buyer, and wrote “Happy to have you represent me.” A fourth independent agent read landed Thursday evening calling the price too high, with staging scored 1 of 5 and a pre-inspection named as the cheaper fix.
hotSignals.action: Call Adin, then take the four-read stack to the institutional seller — the ask is not a debate anymore, and the agent handed you a lever that is not a price cut.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE STRONGEST SINGLE WORD ANY AGENT HAS FILED ON THIS BOARD, AND IT IS NOW TWELVE DAYS OLD. Wanda W. of Millennium Homes answered the interest question with “Very” — not yes, very — on a weekend when two other agents in the same 24 hours filed not interested.
hotSignals.action: Call her. Twelve days of silence on a “very” is the cheapest loss on this whole board, and she is the only one of the three who wanted it.

Verify it before Sunday or it evaporates the same way the 4:30 nearly did.

This is the one date on the board where waiting is expensive.

📆 FRI 10/23 — 1709 FIELDSTONE CIR closes. Longest runway on the board. The roof report and inspection addendum went out Thursday 1:21 PM and were acknowledged at 4:06 PM — the buyer's answer is the next thing owed, expected into the weekend.

📭 NOTHING ELSE IS BOOKED ANYWHERE ON THE SHOWING CALENDAR — not one other confirmed future tour, walk-through, inspection or appraisal in the feed. ⚠️ Eleven of your twelve tracked listings have zero forward activity scheduled, including the $1,150,000 listing that has never had a tour booked at all.
